summary: AI Engineer (Agentic & Generative AI) with 3 years of professional full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, including AI agents built for internal use. Built agents and RAG end to end: site-to-agent (hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval on pgvector, eval harness) and multi-agent-research-crew (tool-calling agents on a custom DAG orchestrator). Strong Python and FastAPI, Claude and Gemini APIs, webhooks and CRM integrations, and Claude Code used daily to ship faster.

Lead technology for an Indian AI and tech education brand (Neuronetworks AI Ed Private Limited) offering programmes for students after Class 10
